title: Serve until the complaint quiets
summary: This meets the restless habit of thinking harder while avoiding the next faithful act. The line says service ripens into Naam, and the inner noise begins to fall.
takeaway: Serve, reflect, and let the complaint thin.
lifeApplication: Before another tab, argument, or voice note, do one useful thing for someone nearby. Let service interrupt the mind before complaint becomes your atmosphere.

source.shortMeaning: Service ripens into Naam and quiets inner complaint.
source.lifeApplication: Before asking for more clarity, answer one need and stay with it.

evidence.turn: Serve the Guru until complaint thins and love for the Beloved rises.
